//: Markup-fidelity fixture for popover. CAPABILITY-ONLY (zero scenarios → no render comparison), by the command-palette / split-button precedent: the pre-JS SSR shells of the two wrappers are NOT reconcilable into a single golden, so axis-1 (features↔CSS) + axis-2 (features↔maps) completeness is enforced while the render diff is intentionally skipped. See irreconcilableReason. Feature contract authored from dist/css/main.css (pa-popover block) + snippets/tooltips.html.
irreconcilableReason:
The two wrappers render fundamentally different pre-JS SSR shells: (1) keen's popover/1 renders the FULL overlay inline —
→
— and portals the header/body/close to a global on open (so none of __content/__header/__body/__close exist in its SSR), AND it applies --alignment only in the portal (not on the root element). So keen's SSR has the whole content subtree and both modifiers on the root; svelte's has neither the content nor --alignment on the root. Neither can be made to match the other without breaking its runtime model. The open state + the portaled content are JS-runtime regardless (cssStateElements). The TRIGGER shells DO align on the parts both emit (pa-popover root + data-placement + pa-popover__trigger), but a capability-only fixture is the honest call since a shared render golden can't capture the content divergence.

propsVocabulary.size: sm|lg — popover width (default = medium, no class)
propsVocabulary.alignment: center|end — text-align of the body (RTL-aware; default = start, no class)
propsVocabulary.triggerText: default trigger button text (? by default)
propsVocabulary.title: header title text (rendered in the __header h4)

features.//: Feature→class contract authored from dist/css/main.css. `produces` with {value}; capability.mjs expands + cross-checks against main.css AND each wrapper's map. `produces: null` = structural/native (data-placement attr, trigger/title/content).

placement.note: structural — rendered into the data-placement attribute, no class

size.note: medium is the default and emits no class — excluded from options

alignment.note: start is the default and emits no class — excluded from options

cssStateClasses.//: No JS-applied pa-popover--* modifier beyond the feature-driven size/alignment; this bucket is empty. Kept for the axis-1 reverse-check contract shape.

cssStateElements.//: pa-popover__* elements. __trigger is in BOTH SSR shells (aligned). __content/__header/__body/__close are inline in keen's SSR but PORTALED to a global container by svelte on open — so they are not a shared SSR surface; listed here as runtime/overlay elements rather than a strict-compare surface.
cssStateElements.pa-popover__trigger: the click target button — present in both SSR shells (aligned)
cssStateElements.pa-popover__content: the overlay content box — inline in keen's SSR, portaled by svelte (JS-runtime)
cssStateElements.pa-popover__close: the X close button in the header — same
